provenance.title: Product model · n = 2 · Hotyn-M 1.1
provenance.text: 47 product obligations → 97 elements; the second reading differs ×1.02 in structure. Produces no effort figure of any kind.

provenance.title: Work model · Hotyn-W 1.1
provenance.text: Crossed against the declared technology in three batches → 570 work items on 96 elements. Work the product needs but no declared activity covers is reported as a finding, never invented.

provenance.title: Size classes · n = 2 · Hotyn-D 2.0
provenance.text: Each element classified by counting named things, the enumeration being the justification. Class agreement 87.3%; whole-chain repeat spread ×1.033.

provenance.title: Rate table
provenance.text: External norms in net task hours, gap-blind: never saw a project total, a budget, or a gap a rate would explain.

provenance.title: Outside view · Lytin-R 1.1
provenance.text: Ran in ignorance of all of the above, the unit convention withheld so that it declared its own: funded seats × time, all roles — the same unit the outcome is recorded in.

provenance.title: No method ×20
provenance.text: The requirements and the assumption log handed to a bare agent with no sensor definition, ten times on 26 August and ten more on 27 August, one permitted file read each. Each run declared its own P10–P90; each is drawn as its own thin curve and none is pooled. Their medians spread ×1.85; their mean sits ×1.78 above the chain and above the outcome.

provenance.text: Sealed before the estimate, opened after the number was written down and closed (run 32).
